item.title: A Quick Guide on Writing LaTeX in Neovim
item.description: In the previous post, I shared a configuration for LaTeX Workshop in VS Code. Here I will explain how to build a LaTeX writing environment in Neovim, with particular attention to the snippets I use for mathematics.
